title: [GMCP 203.008.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Complete schemas, primitives, content, and metadata model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-008-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Every MCP primitive and content variant is represented losslessly, including annotations, icons, resource links and embedded resources, binary media, extensions, cache scope/TTL, audience and priority metadata, and JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output contracts. Round-trip fixtures preserve unknown extension fields; schema limits, external-reference policy, Unicode, URI and MIME validation, and canonical serialization are exhaustively tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
